kw.name: Verify Tournament Title
kw.doc: Tournament name and mode badge next to the app name, browser tab title, and the red Mexicano theme.

Full flow for one tournament size. PLAYERS can be RANDOM (4, 8, 12 or 16). EXTRA ROUNDS are played after the scheduled rounds with "Continue playing". NAMES=True enters shuffled names from ['Juhani', 'Mikael', 'Antti', 'Ville', 'Juho', 'Pekka', 'Oskari', 'Eero', 'Laura', 'Maria', 'Anna', 'Emilia', 'Sofia', 'Aino', 'Sanni', 'Elina']; by default the app's default names "Player 1" ... "Player N" are used. PAIRING is the pair selection of the final round: 14-23 (1 & 4 vs 2 & 3, default) or 13-24 (1 & 3 vs 2 & 4). TOURNAMENT is an optional tournament name.

Full flow for one tournament size. PLAYERS can be RANDOM (4, 8, 12 or 16). EXTRA ROUNDS are played after the scheduled rounds with "Continue playing". NAMES=True enters shuffled names from ['Juhani', 'Mikael', 'Antti', 'Ville', 'Juho', 'Pekka', 'Oskari', 'Eero', 'Laura', 'Maria', 'Anna', 'Emilia', 'Sofia', 'Aino', 'Sanni', 'Elina']; by default the app's default names "Player 1" ... "Player N" are used. PAIRING is the pair selection of the final round: 14-23 (1 & 4 vs 2 & 3, default) or 13-24 (1 & 3 vs 2 & 4). TOURNAMENT is an optional tournament name.

kw.name: Verify Tournament Title
kw.doc: Tournament name and mode badge next to the app name, browser tab title, and the red Mexicano theme.

Full flow for one tournament size. PLAYERS can be RANDOM (4, 8, 12 or 16). EXTRA ROUNDS are played after the scheduled rounds with "Continue playing". NAMES=True enters shuffled names from ['Juhani', 'Mikael', 'Antti', 'Ville', 'Juho', 'Pekka', 'Oskari', 'Eero', 'Laura', 'Maria', 'Anna', 'Emilia', 'Sofia', 'Aino', 'Sanni', 'Elina']; by default the app's default names "Player 1" ... "Player N" are used. PAIRING is the pair selection of the final round: 14-23 (1 & 4 vs 2 & 3, default) or 13-24 (1 & 3 vs 2 & 4). TOURNAMENT is an optional tournament name.
